text:
Something like a shared blackboard that allows for agent orchestration to really save money. Scouts hunt for things and post to the blackboard what they find and then maybe workers can pull from the blackboard get instructions from an orchestrator on what to do and they can post to the blackboard probably in some way what they did so that the orchestrator can call out to a review and a review and post to a new worker to edit and that's kind of like the process of how all this stuff is done and then the parent orchestration agent I don't know how we want to do proof but I don't want them to ever really have to read all the files for the implementation.

It could be like maybe not a reviewer but a validator subagent that it calls with like the git diff and what the plan was. Say is this plan fully implemented and just get a thumbs up post it again to the blackboard like the blackboard is essentially the entire orchestration layer and it you know you should be able to pull it up and monitor it.

Probably like a tabbed overlay for the given in progress session.
something similar to /btw for small ask and answer from agent with or without current context but the answer does not populate into the chat

way to connect a editor session in something like helix to pi to send over highlighted lines as a line range with a comment to give the agent exact feedback on what you dont like. Maybe it should include the line itself too, not sure yet
